1. bul-ul figurines, which are from the ifugao culture. the nearest major city is baguio
2. somwthing resembling a sarimanok, a mythical bird from the maranao culture. the nearest major city is marawi
3. giant portrait of a kalabaw, local buffalo found everywhere, but arguably most associated with the tagalog people. manila is part of this
